english.title: Furnish false / misleading information to officer acting in execution of Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance of a requirement mentioned in regulation 15(1)(b) of the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), furnished information which you knew to be, or recklessly furnished information which was, false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE / MISLEADING INFORMATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 15(2) and 17(3) of the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
